Nicotinyl Alcohol Tartrate (BANM) Alcohol nicotinílico, tartrato de; Nicotinyl Tartrate. 3-Pyridyl- methanol hydrogen (2R,3R)-tartrate. C6H7NO,C4H6O6 = 259.2. CAS — 6164-87-0. ATC — C04AC02; C10AD05. ATC Vet — QC04AC02; QC10AD05. Pharmacopoeias. In Br. BP 2008 (Nicotinyl Alcohol Tartrate). A white or almost white, odourless or almost odourless, crystalline powder. Freely soluble in water; slightly soluble in alcohol; practically insoluble in chlo- roform and in ether. A 5% solution in water has a pH of 2.8 to 3.7. Profile Nicotinyl alcohol is a vasodilator and lipid regulating drug with general properties similar to those of nicotinic acid (p.1957), to which it is partly hydrolysed. Nicotinyl alcohol has been given orally, as the tartrate, in the management of peripheral vascular disease, and has also been used in Ménière’s disease and in hyperlipidaemias. Preparations BP 2008: Nicotinyl Alcohol Tablets. Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Indon.: Cetacol; Pol.: Nicotol†. Multi-ingredient: Braz.: Lipofacton.
